about: Generated imagery for the My Dealer (mydealermn.com) redesign pitch, design 'Sketchbook Noir'. Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project>. Every result is AI-generated and illustrative: never a picture of My Dealer's store, staff, customers or products. g- ids are editorial still lifes on ink, wood or stone; s- ids are wordless pencil or ink concept sketches on plain white paper (templates multiply them onto cream and invert them onto ink).

defaults.style: no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, all surfaces blank and unmarked
